title: Smuggler’s Bounty Final Boxes EVER!!!
text: Smugglers Bounty went through a lot. It was wonderful and then not so wonderful. Unfortunately, there’s only TWO boxes left before it’s gone forever. I have enjoyed most of them and perhaps they could’ve continued by adding more interesting trinkets, but perhaps it will evolve into something better as they said something new will come after this is done. So get your October box and get the last box in December. Hopefully they go out with a Bang!!
label: positive
